objective.name: pilot_intention
objective.description: Defines one Brique intention decided by a pilot: its identifier, the capacity it addresses, and the parameters it carries, before the runtime enriches it for dispatch.

functional._id_note: Required. Unique identifier of the intention within the continuity. Assigned by agentic_core: the pilot never provides it and never designates an intention by it; a wait_group waits for all the awaited intentions of its output; the answer to the intention carries the identifier back.
functional._target_capacity_note: Required. Explicit absolute reference to the Brique capacity addressed by the intention.
functional._parameters_note: Required. Parameters passed to the target capacity according to its retrieved contract.
functional._await_response_note: Required. Boolean chosen by the pilot. false: fire-and-forget, the invoke is non-blocking and no result is expected or tracked; the intention can never be referenced by a wait_group. true: the Response is expected and may be referenced by a wait_group through expected.ref equal to id.
functional._target_type_note: Required. Family of the target capacity (user, matter, reflexive, execution or control). Assigned by agentic_core from the pilot_definition and from the names of the engine capacities: the pilot never provides it; user is the default for an unknown capacity.
